single_message: Connect approved job sources so a scope change becomes a source-linked draft variation before changed work begins, while the builder keeps scope, price, contract and customer decisions.

Stop changed work at a clear human gate for scope, price, timing and customer approval

angle: Protect job margin by comparing the approved quote with revised plans, customer messages and site notes before preparing a reviewable variation
